introduction_paragraph: Join us in the summer for our captain-led practices! It's a great opportunity to start your running journey and meet the team. No coaches will be present.
communication_text: Follow MGXC on Instagram or join the captains practice GroupMe for any weather related cancellations or other scheduling updates.
what_text: Our captain-led practices bring new and experienced runners a personalized training plan, team workouts, strength training exercises, and a team bonding experience.
when_text: Captains practice runs mid-June through mid-August, Monday through Friday. Practice times are from 8:30 - 10:00 on a typical day. For summer events, weather updates, and changes in the schedule, you can find updates on the [MGXC Instagram.](https://www.instagram.com/mg.crosscountry/)
where_text: Practice locations may change year to year. For the 2026 season, practice can be found at the field near the main lot of the high school.
who_text: Practice is open to anyone! Whether you’re a beginner looking to join the team, undecided, or a veteran runner, this program works with everyone!. Practices are led by a group of team captains, decided by the coaches and voted in by the team of the previous year.
